tool_input.command:
S=plugins/dev-graph/scripts; R=$PWD
python3 $S/validate-graph-schema.py --graph $R/.dev-graph/state/graph.json --repo-root $R --strict-artifact-readiness; echo "EXIT=$?"
python3 $S/validate-source-lineage.py --repo-root $R; echo "EXIT=$?"
python3 $S/resolve-repo-context.py --repo-root $R --mode read; echo "EXIT=$?"
python3 $S/build-graph-node.py add --repo-root $R --input eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/R3-import/import-payload.json --dry-run; echo "EXIT=$?"
shasum -a 256 .dev-graph/state/graph.json; git status --short
